agent.description: Identity and prompt of the agent.

displayName.description: Human-friendly name, Unicode allowed. Rendered as the ui.giantswarm.io/display-name annotation on the AgentTemplate. Size-limited so it cannot become a description.

iconUrl.description: Fully qualified URL of the agent's avatar icon. Rendered as the ui.giantswarm.io/icon-url annotation on the AgentTemplate (the template has no icon field). Populated by the Backstage agent-creation flow with the canonical avatar URL.

name.description: Technical resource name (DNS-1123). Defaults to the Helm release name.

annotations.description: Extra annotations merged next to the display-name and icon-url annotations.

extraAgentSpec.description: Escape hatch: deep-merged over the curated AgentTemplate spec (this wins), so any kagent.dev/v1alpha3 AgentTemplate field is reachable when the curated surface omits something. Never reaches the Harness or the RemoteMCPServer.

extraTools.description: Additional raw kagent.dev/v1alpha3 tool bindings appended after the agent's muster binding.

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts
global.$comment: Added automatically by 'helm schema' to allow this chart to be used as a Helm dependency, as this schema would otherwise not allow Helm's special 'global' values key.

labels.description: Extra labels merged over the standard set, e.g. tenant/owner dimensions.

modelConfig.description: Which platform-admin-provisioned ModelConfig the agent uses, referenced by name. kagent resolves it in the agent's own namespace. The chart never creates or mutates a ModelConfig, and tenants never handle LLM credentials.

name.description: Name of the admin-provisioned ModelConfig in the agent's namespace.

muster.description: The platform's muster MCP gateway, reached through the agent's own RemoteMCPServer (named after the agent, same namespace) that carries the X-Muster-Toolset header.

enabled.description: Render the agent's muster RemoteMCPServer and bind it in the AgentTemplate's tools.

tools.description: Set to narrow the tool surface of the binding (spec.tools[].mcp.tools); leave empty for every tool the gateway exposes. Enforced by a Harness only when it can discover the server's tools.

url.description: The muster MCP URL the agent's RemoteMCPServer points at (spec.url). Default: the platform's in-cluster muster MCP URL, http://muster.agent-platform.svc.cluster.local:8090/mcp.

skills.description: Skills the agent mounts, each pinned to an immutable source: a git commit or an OCI digest. A branch, a tag, a short SHA or an OCI tag fails the render.

git.description: A skill in a git repository, pinned to a full commit id.

commit.description: Full commit id (40 or 64 hex characters).

name.description: Name of the skill under the template (unique per agent).

path.description: Subdirectory of the repository holding SKILL.md, relative without '..'; empty for the repository root.

toolset.description: The tools the agent is composed with: a list of selectors that muster resolves per request. Selectors are `preset:<name>`, `server:<name>`, `workflow:<name>` or `tool:<name>` with exact, case-sensitive names (regex `^(preset|server|workflow|tool):[^\s,]+$`); at most 32 inline, define a preset for more. `toolset:<name>` is reserved and refused; patterns, excludes, the read-only predicate and `label:` exist only inside presets. Rendered as the static `X-Muster-Toolset` header on the agent's RemoteMCPServer (spec.headersFrom, the selectors joined by `,`). Exactly `["preset:none"]` renders NO RemoteMCPServer and no muster binding at all, so a chat-only agent pays no context for meta-tools; an empty list fails the render (say `preset:none` instead). Unset (the default) renders no header and the agent keeps implicit full access to everything the gateway exposes to the invoking human. Built-in presets: `read-only`, `none`, `full`; the platform charts ship `infrastructure` and `agent-platform`. Composition, not authorization: the human's identity and the backends' own authorization stay the boundary.
